$comment: Ders/kurs içerik katmanı — Ostinato library.json / JabLab library_test.dart desenini uyarlar (M-F-103/108).
Kütüphane -> Hareket sayfası -> Kurs -> Ders (W0-BILGI-MIMARISI §1). Her hareket KENDİ sayfası.
ELLE YAZILAN İDDİA YOKTUR: her lesson'ın açık/kilitli olması bir ÖLÇÜME dayanır ve
tools/validate_library.py bunu mekanik olarak denetler (LLM-denetim değil, aile kuralı).
DÜRÜSTLÜK KURALLARI (validate_library.py):
1. status=coming_soon olan harekette KURS OLAMAZ (sahte kurs listelenmez).
2. Her kursun en az 1 dersi olmak zorunda (boş kurs listelenmez).
3. Ders, katalogda BULUNMAYAN formError'a atıf yapamaz.
4. Her harekette honesty bloku ZORUNLU (measurementContract'ten türer, elle yazılmaz — W0 §3).
5. status=locked olan her ders lockedReason taşımak zorunda; lockedReason EŞİK DEĞERİ değil,
EKSİK ÖLÇÜMÜN adı olmalı.
6. comingSoon maddeleri gerekçesiz olamaz.
--- Gravita'ya ÖZEL dört kural (kopya değil, aynı gerekçenin bu ürüne düşen hâli): ---
7. gradesFormAgainstReference=true olan AÇIK bir ders, `gradedJoints` ile NOTLADIĞI eklemleri
BEYAN etmek ve her birinin provenance.derivedJoints içinde olduğunu göstermek zorunda;
referansın unreliableJoints'indeki bir eklem de notlanamaz. Gerekçe G-050/G-014: taban-bağlı
(floor) tolerans VARYANS-TÜRETİMLİ SAYILMAZ. ⚠️ Kural ilk hâlinde yalnız 'derivedJoints boş mu'
diye soruyordu; squat referansı DELİĞİ gösterdi (G-072): squat'ın varyans-türetimli eklemleri
KOL, notlayacağı eklemler BACAK. 'Bir yerde varyans var', 'NOTLADIĞIM yerde varyans var'ın
yerine geçemez — vekil ölçen kapı sınıfı hata.
8. status=live olan bir harekette engine.precondition.status DERIVED olmak zorunda.
Gerekçe G-043: kimlik ön koşulu yoksa tekrar FSM'i hareketi değil salınımı sayar
(ayakta konuşan birinin dizi de bükülür). ⚠️ Bu kural, `preconditionStatus` beyanının
ÜRÜN tarafındaki İLK tüketicisidir — beşinci canlılık sorusu (G-059).
9. status=locked olan her ders `lockClass: measurement` + `blockedBy` taşımalı; her bloker
DOĞRULANIR ve artık bloklamıyorsa BAYAT KİLİT hatası verir. Sebebi ölmüş bir kilit
sessizce durmaz. Yapı/ekran kilidi ÖLÇÜM kilidi gibi sunulamaz.
10. status=live olan hareket EN AZ 1 kurs taşımak zorunda — kural 1'in İKİZİ (M-F-194).
'coming_soon'da kurs olamaz' tek başına YARIM kapıdır: kurs HEM buradan HEM katalogdan
düşerse iki kaynak birbiriyle TUTARLI kalır, çelişki kapısı susar ve hareket 'canlı'
etiketiyle BOŞ açılır (G-105'te ölçüldü: yakalanmıyordu). `live` = 'girebileceğin bir şey
var' iddiası; girilecek şey yoksa hareketin durumu coming_soon'dur.
Ürün dili İngilizce (PRD §7, V1 yalnız `en`); bu $comment iç dokümandır.

movements.blurb: Set your phone down side-on so it can see you from head to heels. We count your reps, time your tempo, and tell you when a rep didn't go deep enough.

measured: Rep count — the engine refuses to count unless your torso is actually horizontal (identity gate)
notMeasured: Force or load
Muscle activation
Hand pressure distribution

How your form compares to instructors. We now have an ATTESTED reference from 5 instructors (36 takes) — but not one of the 9 joint tolerances came out of their measured disagreement; all 9 still sit at our default floor. Until that changes we count and time your reps, we do not grade your shape against a reference.

Which side is doing more work. We cannot tell your left from your right reliably in this camera setup, and our own reference confirms it: left-right joint difference measures 14.7 degrees, and it collapses to about 13 degrees exactly when the far limb becomes invisible to the model (it reads ~37 degrees when the model can see both). A small left-right difference here is the model guessing, not you being symmetric.
honesty.scoring: None of this is a score. We count and time what is listed above, and when a rule fires we tell you what to change — but no number grades your form, on this movement or any other in Gravita. Form grading stays shut until joint tolerances come from measured disagreement between real instructors rather than from our default floor.

courses.goal: Get honest rep counting and tempo on your push-up, and learn which depth actually counts.

lessons._why_unlocked: Bu dersin dayandığı üç ölçüm de CANLI: (1) kimlik ön koşulu DERIVED ve üründe aktif (torso_angle_from_vertical>=60, G-043 — ayakta el hareketi tekrar SAYILMIYOR, testi var); (2) rep FSM 69/69 test yeşil ve replay kapısında push_up'ın 8 biriminin 8'i GERÇEK veride ateşleniyor, 0 ölü; (3) tempo eşik geçişinden değil gerçek dönüş anından ölçülüyor (G-055) — yani sayım eşiği değişse tempo bozulmuyor. partial_rom İSİMLİ ürün eşiği (110°) ve G-054'ten beri gerçek veride ateşleniyor. Hiçbiri referans toleransına bağlı DEĞİL.

lessons.lockedReason: We can see your body line, but we can't grade it. Our instructor reference is attested (5 instructors, 36 takes) — but not one of the nine joint tolerances came out of the instructors' measured disagreement; every one still sits at our default floor. A 'good line' number would come from that default, not from real instructors, so we won't score you against it. Rep counting and depth are unaffected and stay open.

comingSoonInThisMovement: Tempo (down/up timing) — the engine measures it from the real turnaround point, not from a threshold crossing, and that is proven on recorded footage. But no screen in this app shows it to you, so we do not count it as something you get.
Elbow range of motion per rep — same situation: the engine computes it for every rep, and nothing in the app displays it.

Being told a rep was too shallow — the shallow-rep rule fires correctly on recorded footage (8 of 8 rules live in the replay gate), but during a live session no cue appears on screen, so nothing actually tells you.

Body-line grading (hip sag / pike / head drop / uneven press) — the rules fire correctly on real footage and the reference is now ATTESTED, but no joint tolerance is variance-derived (derivedJoints empty; all 9 floor-bound), so we show the cue and never a score
Side-dependent cues ("your left arm is...") — the pose model's left/right labels are not trustworthy in this camera setup, so all rules stay side-agnostic
Hand pressure and load — a single camera cannot see either; this is a permanent limit, not a pending measurement
safetyWarnings: Stop if you feel sharp shoulder or wrist pain — that is different from muscular effort.

movements.blurb: Squat coaching is closed. We now have an instructor reference, but two things are still missing before we'd grade you — details below, in plain terms.

notMeasured: Nothing is graded. Two things are still missing, and each one alone is enough for us to keep this closed.

The engine has no squat identity check. For push-ups we verify your torso is horizontal before counting a rep; the equivalent test for squats hasn't been derived, so nothing would stop a rep being counted while you're just standing and moving.
The squat error rules have never been run against real footage — there is no replay fixture for this movement, so we have no evidence they fire when they should.

What the reference can and cannot support: it is attested (5 instructors, 25 takes). Hip and thigh tolerances now come from measured instructor spread — but knee, shin and torso are still at our default floor, and knee depth plus torso lean are exactly what a squat coach would grade. We rebuilt this reference after finding that six of its takes were loaded BARBELL squats, one of them the alignment basis for everything else; removing them is what let hip and thigh become measurement-backed.

Left/right comparisons are off the table — for squats AND push-ups. Measured left-right joint difference is 32.0 degrees for squats and 14.7 degrees for push-ups; neither reference is mirror-agnostic, so we make no side-specific claim from eitherrule 7). We previously reported 5.2 degrees for push-ups and treated it as evidence of symmetry — that was wrong twice over: the number averaged differences that cancelled out instead of measuring how big they are, and the small difference itself came from the model copying the limb it cannot see rather than from real symmetry.
Knee tracking side-to-side (valgus) — needs a front-facing camera. Permanent limit for this setup.
Weight distribution across the foot, force, or load — a single camera cannot see these.

comingSoonInThisMovement: Rep counting and depth — blocked on the identity precondition (engine.precondition.status is 'pending', conditions list empty), because counting reps without an identity check counts limb swing, not squats

Depth and torso-angle grading — this is the one we most want to open, and it is the one still missing its measurement. We rebuilt the reference after finding six of its takes were loaded barbell squats (one of them the alignment basis), and that fixed hip and thigh: those tolerances now come from measured instructor disagreement. But knee, shin and torso are still at our default floor — and knee depth plus torso lean are exactly what depth grading needs. More instructors is the likely fix, not a code change.

Any left-vs-right feedback — neither reference is mirror-agnostic (32.0 degrees measured for squats, 14.7 for push-ups), so side-specific judgements are structurally unavailable, not merely pending. Our rules are side-agnostic by design anyway.

Butt wink (lower-back rounding at the bottom) — the lumbar proxy metric carries landmark jitter risk at deep flexion and is marked pendingVerification, so it would not be graded even once the tolerance question is settled
safetyWarnings: Stop at the depth you can control with a neutral spine.
